attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.module = '_client'
  AND f.package = 'httpx'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.qualname NOT LIKE 'BaseClient.%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.headings h
    WHERE h.file_id = s.file_id
      AND h.heading = s.name
  )
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
